name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Addressing
proof: On the addressing class, the established VC and Littlestone dimensions both equal $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$. The surveyed sandwich theorem places Prefix-k Littlestone Dimension between them, determining the same value for every fixed k.
references: Derived from Proposition \ref{prop:prefix-littlestone-order} in the survey and the established addressing benchmark values
